lines.text: Many learners say: Can you borrow me a pen?
Better: Can you lend me a pen?
Borrow is take. Lend is give.
Lend! Can you lend me a pen?

data.wrong: Can you borrow me a pen?
data.right: Can you lend me a pen?
data.why: Borrow is take. Lend is give.

native.hook: borrow 和 lend 别混淆！
native.tip: borrow 是“借进”，lend 是“借出”；让别人借给你要说 lend me。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “Can you borrow me a pen?”？😅 borrow 是借入，lend 是借出，别搞反：“Can you lend me a pen?”。跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“lend”。借给我用 lend！免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Borrow means to take; lend means to give. Ask someone to lend you things.
en.caption: Do you say “Can you borrow me a pen?”? 😅 Borrow means taking, lend means giving: “Can you lend me a pen?”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
